content.text:
The site looked different because the web font wasn't loading, and it's fixed now.

`site/css/tokens.css` pointed at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is `site/fonts/`. The browser couldn't find the font, so every page fell back to the system font. I changed the path to `../fonts/`.

I re-ran the visual tests. All 12 snapshots (6 pages, desktop and phone) now match the approved baselines, where before all 12 differed. I didn't run the functional tests, and I haven't committed the change.

STATUS: DONE
